refines.transition: docs/I01_TRANSITIONS.md section 3, continental separation (atlas.rift-decoupling-handoff.v1 stays the mechanical handoff)

decision.representation: laterally resolved long-wave chain of material columns, each the accepted finite-strain column, carrying one transmitted force set by the D1 drive/drag balance; every column thins by its own pure shear with its own temperature and history
decision.trigger: connectivity loss: the thinnest column reaches zero thickness after finite opening and time; only a future resolved certificate may issue atlas.connectivity-loss-event.v1
decision.established: ANALYTICAL_CONTINUUM_PINCH_FEASIBLE only: the exact continuum solution of one fixed single-mechanism power law (constant n, time-independent A(X), gravity/GPE disabled, isothermal) with a non-degenerate quadratic weakness minimum pinches off at finite opening and time for 2 < n <= 4, with sampled and limiting neck slopes inside the long-wave bound; the time-stepped chain and lateral refinement of the exact discrete chain are checked only at the first detection level h = 0.1 H (n = 3)
decision.resolved_event: UNRESOLVED, not implemented: a resolved connectivity-loss certificate needs a constitutive basis along the whole approach (not an exponent inferred at one finite state), laterally converged events at every rung used (the rung-12 material neck scale is about 2.29 m for n = 3 and 0.286 m for n = 3.5, against about 293 m columns at N = 2048), long-wave validity from the law's asymptotics, declared thermal and GPE coupling errors, and the event record; generated breakup of the retained lithosphere remains unresolved
decision.criterion: a = A(X)(F/2h)^n with one constant n and a time-independent A(X); column strength f = h0^n/A with a unique minimum f_min where 1 - f_min/f = c|X - X0|^q (1 + o(1)), c > 0, and bounded away from zero elsewhere: finite opening at pinch-off iff n > q; q = 2 for a non-degenerate quadratic minimum; a smooth quartic minimum has q = 4 and gives no finite-opening pinch-off for n = 3; flat minima and uniform belts never separate
decision.admitted: analytical feasibility only for the declared fixed power law with a constant 2 < n <= 4 and the non-degenerate quadratic profile; an effective exponent inferred at a finite state is a regime diagnostic, not a constant-power-law basis
refused: REFUSED_REQUIRES_RESOLVED_NECK: rate-independent or plastic-dominated (frictional or regularised-plastic) states sampled at finite stress; a regime the reduced chain does not support, requiring resolved x-z mechanics (I07); eventual breakup unresolved, not excluded
REFUSED_OUTSIDE_LONG_WAVE_VALIDITY: n > 4 from the asymptotic tip slope (H/ell)(h/H)^((4-n)/2), whatever the sampled slopes, or a sampled or limiting neck slope above the bound
REFUSED_UNSUPPORTED_BASIS: any law, profile or provenance other than the declared fixed power law with a non-degenerate quadratic minimum
NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_FINITE_LIMIT: thinning without a finite-opening limit (n <= 2 for the quadratic minimum, flat or fixed-width necks)
decision.state_change: the belt must carry lateral material resolution (I05); the accepted affine strip and any fixed material set cannot reach zero thickness at finite opening

distinctions.mechanical_decoupling: belt share phi = F_t/F_drive <= eps_v (D6 atlas.rift-decoupling-handoff.v1); the material stays connected; no boundary split and no new area
distinctions.material_separation: atlas.connectivity-loss-event.v1 issued only by a future resolved certificate; split by current material position at the neck; both margins keep cohorts, ages, heat and D2 memory
distinctions.magmatic_ocean_birth: D3 atlas.decompression-supply.v1 after separation with an actual melt and enthalpy source; otherwise exhumed mantle, never relabelled as basalt

rejected_routes.thickness_or_strain_cutoff: no physical law; the event time and opening depend on the cutoff and have no limit (D6 separation control)
rejected_routes.low_resistance_or_decoupling_as_breakup: a mechanical handoff only; the material stays connected (no_pinch control)
rejected_routes.prescribed_event: tests transfers in prescribed_history_v1; never a generated transition
rejected_routes.resolved_2d_rift_inside_i01: physically complete (Brune et al. 2014; ASPECT continental extension) but a full regional solver owned by I07; required for brittle necks
rejected_routes.embrittlement_plus_fault_kinematics: whole-crust embrittlement is a regime diagnostic; separation by a supplied fault geometry is prescribed kinematics; used here only as the refusal classifier
rejected_routes.universal_fracture_energy_or_brittle_man: no supported universal lithospheric fracture energy; a brittle law is not applied to the ductile mantle
rejected_routes.magma_assisted_breakup: needs a calibrated melt-supply or dyke-opening law that Atlas does not have

ports.force_d1: F_drive - D v(F_t) = F_t with v = sum dX_i lambda_i a_i(F_t + dU_i): a monotone scalar root with independent retained column inversions (respond_force)
ports.gpe_d1_d5: F_i = F_t + (U_i - U_ref), U from the I01 GPE column law on the same columns; no separate ridge-push line force; the feasibility controls deliberately disable gravity/GPE, and equal density structure alone would not make U_i - U_ref vanish for columns of different thickness
ports.temperature_d4: accepted material-coordinate thermal clock per column with its own lambda_i(t); lateral conduction omitted and not bounded by the slope check, because flat columns can carry sharp lateral temperature differences; a future coupling must declare a thermal length/time/gradient error criterion; fixed material-base temperature or a declared asthenosphere inflow account; the controls here are isothermal and need no thermal solver
ports.history_d2: raw plastic history per column, never filtered across the neck in the chain; the D2 nonlocal length belongs to the resolved I07 neck
ports.material: exact volume per column; splitting a column into identical halves is exact; separation splits ownership by current material position
ports.event_d6: atlas.connectivity-loss-event.v1 (future resolved certificate only): parent, interval, law, ladder, ratios, local exponent, lateral changes, slope, neck position, split rule, handoff error, new boundary identity, D3 supply owner, status or refusal

units.time: s; the chain integrates tau = t v_inf/Lambda with Lambda = integral alpha dX
units.rate_prefactor: A(X) = A_max alpha(X); A_max is fixed by the declared initial belt share
units.parallel_plastic: dimensionless: stress in units of the yield stress Y, rate in units of Y/(2 eta), scaled creep k = 2 eta A Y^(n-1)

control_policy.scope: long-wave necking chain under one transmitted force; exact power-law controls; analytical continuum pinch feasibility for a fixed power law with a non-degenerate quadratic minimum; no resolved connectivity-loss certificate; retained column classified read-only; not rupture, ocean birth or calibration

parameter_provenance.chain: H = 100 km is the accepted finite-strain strip thickness; drive 2e13 N/m and drag 5e22 Pa s are the reviewed motion-case values, checked against the retained context at run time; L = 300 km, ell = 600 km and the initial belt share 1/2 are authored
parameter_provenance.exponents: 3 and 3.5 lie inside the analytical window (2, 4] (wet anorthite and dry olivine dislocation creep in the retained case, from the ASPECT continental-extension parameter file; wet quartzite there is 4); 1 and 2 are subcritical; 5 lies above the long-wave window; all authored control choices
parameter_provenance.fixed_neck_width_m: equals physical_length_m of cases/i01_fault2d_v1.json (authored D2 fixture), read and compared at run time
parameter_provenance.slender_thickness_m: authored: a belt 100 times thinner than the control belt, whose sampled n = 5 neck slopes all stay inside the bound; it tests that n > 4 is refused from the asymptotics, not from sampled slopes
parameter_provenance.parallel_plastic: authored scaled point law r = k sigma^n + max(sigma - 1, 0) of the retained additive creep plus regularised-plastic form; a mathematical counterexample independent of the mantle fixture, whose coefficients are not extrapolated; not a physical state
parameter_provenance.retained: order 64 is the accepted finite-strain reference order; stretches lie inside the frozen [0.6, 1.4] window; the rate ladder and classification thresholds are authored
parameter_provenance.gates: authored numerical gates frozen before execution; reasons are given in section 9 of the method document; none is a geological constant

acceptance_claim: Passing demonstrates only the reduced mathematical slice and its refusals: the exact continuum solution of the declared fixed power law with a non-degenerate quadratic minimum is analytically feasible for 2 < n <= 4, the time-stepped chain matches the exact discrete chain at the first detection level, and the other regimes are refused or not established. No resolved connectivity-loss event is certified; general event certification is UNRESOLVED and not implemented. It does not accept generated breakup in any world, brittle rupture, ocean birth or calibration; the retained layered column is classified at sampled states, not run in the chain, and its eventual breakup is unresolved.
